lines.text: You'd blame the owner. But the reason this SUV never moved was parked right behind it.
Case file: green SUV, slot nine.
Month one. Dust.
Month four. Wash me, on the window.
Month eight. The guard's laundry, on the bonnet.
Month eleven. Pigeons. A whole family. On the roof.
So the colony builds theories.
Priya: a wedding gift nobody wanted.
Arjun: the owner is a spy.
Sharma ji: haunted. The wipers moved once.
Then Rohan's car goes for a service. One weekend.
Monday, the SUV reverses out. First time ever.
Rohan had parked behind it. Every night. For a year.
Mr Iyer, the owner, was too polite to knock. He took autos to Rohan's office.
So four uncles guide a reverse. Everyone yelling, aao aao.
Fourteen point turn. One scooter down. Back in slot nine.
Lesson: the car blocking you is usually going your way.
So Iyer joined Rohan's carpool. Inside an app.
The roster picks the driver, and that car sleeps in front.
Iyer walks down. One tap: he's at the pickup.
Pickup point's name? The SUV. Still hasn't moved.
The pigeons approve.
Boxed in by a neighbour's car? Try Sahyatri. Link in bio.

post.title: A year in slot 9: the SUV mystery solved 🕵️
post.caption: A spotless SUV sat in slot 9 for a whole year. Dust, laundry, pigeons, three wild theories. Then one weekend, one car went missing and the case cracked. Tag the neighbour who always parks behind you.
